# Builds the C sources generated by TeaVM, which are in c/ (see README.md)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if (NOT DEFINED CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "")
	set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type")
endif()

project(hello C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)

set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O2")
add_compile_options(-w)

# The heap of the program: -DHEAP_MB=n gives it n MB (min = max). By default it is the one
# TeaVM generated (1 MB to 16 MB). The layout of the memory changes with it, and with it
# the way the failure shows up (see README.md).
set(HEAP_MB "" CACHE STRING "Size of the heap in MB (default: the one of TeaVM)")

# all.txt lists every generated .c file
file(STRINGS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/c/all.txt GEN_FILES)
foreach(F IN LISTS GEN_FILES)
	if (F STREQUAL "main.c" AND NOT HEAP_MB STREQUAL "")
		file(READ ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/c/main.c MAIN_C)
		math(EXPR HEAP_BYTES "${HEAP_MB} * 1048576")
		string(REGEX REPLACE "teavm_initHeap\\([0-9]+, [0-9]+\\)"
				"teavm_initHeap(${HEAP_BYTES}, ${HEAP_BYTES})" MAIN_C "${MAIN_C}")
		# the copy of main.c is not next to its headers: give their full path (no -I: TeaVM
		# generates a string.h that must not hide the one of the system)
		string(REGEX REPLACE "#include \"([^\"]+)\"" "#include \"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/c/\\1\"" MAIN_C "${MAIN_C}")
		file(WRITE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/main.c "${MAIN_C}")
		list(APPEND GEN_SOURCES ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/main.c)
	else()
		list(APPEND GEN_SOURCES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/c/${F})
	endif()
endforeach()

add_executable(hello ${GEN_SOURCES})
target_link_libraries(hello m rt)
